name: Craft Vessel
description:
Casting time: 10 minutes.

You transform a mundane object into a magic vessel capable of capturing and holding a creature. The object may be anything with an opening that can be sealed - a glass phial, a seashell, an iron flask, a wooden box, etc. You adorn the object with special components of your choosing.

The treasure you spend on the special components sets the keeping for that vessel:

  • Spend 1 treasure to craft a modest vessel.

  • Spend 2 treasure to craft a comfortable vessel.

  • Spend 3 treasure to craft a prosperous vessel.

  • Spend 4 treasure to craft an opulent vessel.

You cannot craft a wretched vessel. The vessel's keeping makes it more likely to capture a creature - see the Capture ability.

Describe the vessel you create.
